evals.prompt: Add a druxt.js contributor skill that walks someone through updating the perf-audit baseline.
evals.expected_output: Creates .agents/skills/<verb-object-name>/ with SKILL.md using only spec frontmatter, a description with 'Use when', evals/evals.json and evals/triggers.json, adds it to the AGENTS.md Skills table, and runs yarn lint:skills.
expectations: Creates the skill under .agents/skills, not .claude/skills directly
Writes evals/evals.json and evals/triggers.json for it
Adds the skill to the Skills table in AGENTS.md

evals.prompt: Should 'every @param needs a type and description' go in a new druxt.js skill or somewhere else?
evals.expected_output: Says a one-line rule that applies to every session belongs in AGENTS.md (where it already is), not a new skill.
expectations: Recommends AGENTS.md for a one-line rule that applies everywhere
Does not create a new skill for it
